newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - National Surgery raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - National Surgery raised.

text.p: -- Southcoast Capital Corp said it raised National Surgery Centers Inc's short-term rating to buy from hold and maintained a long-term rating of buy.

-- In January, Southcoast had cut National Surgery's short-term rating to hold from buy based on price. Now that the price has hit $30 a share at the close of Tuesday's session, Southcoast said it is boosting National Surgery's short-term rating back to buy.
-- said the company's acquisition pipeline continues to expand.
-- raised the 12-month price target range to $36-$38 a share from $33-$35 a share.
